properties.name: A clean sweep says what it could not have covered, so a zero is never read wider than the ground it walked
properties.statement:
Any detector reporting no findings must also report what it examined. A clean result over a population of zero is indistinguishable from a clean result over everything, and the two mean opposite things.

THE NEED, from the measurement: `circular_dependency` walked 182 dependency pairs on this design and found nothing — while ZERO of those pairs joined two subsystems. The result was SILENT about the subsystems rather than clean about them, and nothing in the reply said so. Measured 2026-08-20.

This is the general form and it binds every detector, present and future — including ones written after the capability that prompted it, which is precisely what a requirement derived from that capability's description could never do.
